run_chameleon_batch_streaming: run a Chameleon model to stream token generation for a batch of text prompts
create_chameleon_inference_model: create a ChameleonInferenceModel with model path, text tokenizer, and VQGAN config files
stream_batch_prompts: stream token generation for multiple text prompts using the Chameleon model's stream method
